name: zvideo_fxpass3_apply_to_current_surface
description: zVideo::FxPass3_ApplyToCurrentSurface applies the animated radial pass-3 warp to the active 16-bit FX surface using full-surface or clipped scatter paths.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session; defer to a coherent zVideo FxPass3 source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation for 0x48daf0 validates fastcall center coordinates, stack-passed radius/extent/sine/clip arguments, current-radius clamping, alloca-built sine and reciprocal tables, the original approximate square-root radius index, direct and clipped eight-way scatter paths, and copyback from g_zVideo_FxPass3_ScratchPixels16 to g_zVideo_FxSurfacePixels16.
The native FxPass3 smoke verifies the capped-radius no-op case, a full-surface warp sample, and a clipped-path warp sample with the recovered scratch offset globals.
